components.name: DynamicIsland
components.doc: A pill that grows from a resting dot into a compact live activity and on into a full view (call, timer or music), with one spring for every change of shape.

components.name: DynamicIslandPreview
components.doc: Ready preview: the island at the top of a phone screen, with a switch for the activity it shows.

members.name: activity
members.doc: What the island is showing. Pass it with `onActivityChange` to control it.

members.name: defaultActivity
members.doc: Activity at the start when uncontrolled.

members.name: onActivityChange
members.doc: Called when the island changes activity by itself: a call is declined or ended, or a timer is cancelled.

members.name: expanded
members.doc: Whether the island shows the large view of its activity. Pass it with `onExpandedChange` to control it.

members.name: defaultExpanded
members.doc: Whether the island starts expanded when uncontrolled.

members.name: onExpandedChange
members.doc: Called when a tap, Escape or a click outside expands or collapses the island.

members.name: caller
members.doc: Who is calling in the call activity.

members.name: timerSeconds
members.doc: Length of the timer activity in seconds.
